description: Per-dataset targets (items each annotator is asked to label; must end on a block boundary of eval_subset.json, tested) and the short dataset descriptions, shown once in a box when a dataset is selected (and on the first training item of each dataset).

descriptions.AmbiK: Tasks for a kitchen robot. The environment lists the objects in the kitchen.
descriptions.SaGC: Commands given to different kinds of robots (e.g. a cooking or cleaning robot) in a described scene. Judge the command for that robot in that scene.
descriptions.SafeAgentBench: Instructions for a household robot in a simulated home. The list shows the objects the instruction mentions, with their number, state and location, and any that are not in the scene. The full scene description is behind a click.
